name: no-campaign-ran
about: A day with no campaign spending: no campaign rows, the month's spend so far, and the cohorts.

output.headline: No campaigns ran on November 3, 2026, so spend was $0.00 and there were no leads.
points: Campaigns ran on 2026-11-03: 0. Spend was $0.00 with 0 impressions, 0 clicks and no leads, so there is no cost per lead and no click rate for the day.
Spend so far in November 2026 is $400.00 on Meta, with 28 days left in the month.
The 2026-09-28 cohort had 40 leads: 20 converted (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%) and 5 hired (12.5%). 9 applications ended without a hire.
The 2026-09-21 cohort had 38 leads: 17 converted (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%) and 4 hired (10.5%). It did a little worse at each of these stages than the 2026-09-28 cohort.
The 2026-10-26 cohort is too young to judge: of its 12 leads, 9 were contacted, 3 converted and 1 applied, with no hires yet.
There are no lead-quality figures from calls for any campaign over the last 14 days.
